title: System Design in the AI Era
content: The main idea from this episode is simple: system design is not about drawing complicated boxes and arrows, it's about making good decisions about how different parts of the system work together. AI hasn't made system design obsolete; it has added an entirely new layer of decisions to understand. In the next episode, the focus will be on breaking down a high-level overview of what a ChatGPT-like system looks like behind the scenes. See you in the next one.
